summary: Repeated replenishment and agitation of suspended salt ends after dissolution ceases for two days. Floating fish or egg provides a separate brine-strength check. The brine is then exposed until solid; weather controls covering and re-exposure. This source has two distinct endpoints, with the first defined by sustained absence of further change.
limits: English edition read, not native medieval collation.
The source does not instruct removal of the egg or fish; no removal or ingredient-exclusion claim inferred.
No modern medical efficacy claim and no direct Voynich source claim.
